description: President Secretariat - Orders Call out members of the Armed forces for the Maintenance of Public Orders
categorisation: This gazette content involves the exercise of powers under the Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40) to call out armed forces for maintaining public order. This constitutes a legal/regulatory matter as it involves the implementation of existing legislation (a statutory instrument) rather than government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or any of the other specialized categories. The mention of the President's name is incidental to the legal authority being exercised, not the primary focus of the document.
